Grok recommends "Use real name if possible; otherwise, use @MoKetchups with professional bio." This creates unnecessary complexity. Pick one strategy and commit. The switching recommendation signals uncertainty rather than strategic thinking.

Mistral suggests 5 tags including both "Philosophy of AI" and "Game Theory." This dilutes focus. LessWrong's algorithm works better with 3-4 highly relevant tags rather than casting a wide net. "AI Safety," "Original Research," and "LLM" are sufficient for maximum targeted reach.
